topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I heard that one of the village lads, he studied far off in the city, found his words listed in a book. A book! It seems his writings on paper, the essays they call them, were so fine that they used his as an example. I reckon it's a good omen. Just as the saints smile upon a bountiful harvest, the scholars must've seen the truth in his words. It's like planting the right seeds at the right time; if you do, the earth gives back more than you ask. The lad must be pleased, a bit surprised, but also proud. I reckon his family will have a bit more bread on the table from this praise.
